text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before the race, Ines Fujin is trembling with sheer anticipation. I can tell she's even more excited now than she was before her debut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two of us have chased her dream right onto this grand stage, and no doubt she's about to show me where it goes next.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But standing in the way are Mejiro Ryan and Oguri Cap—two rivals whose hearts burn with the determination to live up to their fans' expectations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Without a moment's hesitation, Ines boldly declares that she's going to enjoy this race more than anyone. The Arima Kinen of dreams begins!
